'''Coruschal''' was a [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city world]]<ref name="RPG" /> located in the [[Coruschal system/Legends|Coruschal system]], a part of [[the Negs]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the prominent munitions manufacturing company [[Coruschal WeaponWorks]] until, at one point, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] fell into civil disarray. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Coruschal had become a decaying [[City/Legends|urban]] sprawl. Various factions at war with each other fought in the planet's streets, with the fighting having cut off contact with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coruschal was mentioned in [[Bill Smith]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' [[1996]] core rulebook of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Coruschal [[Star system/Legends|system]], and the planet itself, in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
